notes: wowsims-forever models one Hunter spell package for all three specs (engine spec mapping, design section on the APL rotation lane); Beast Mastery, Marksmanship and Survival share this same Aimed Shot / Multi-Shot weave and differ mainly in which cooldowns and secondary shots they lean on. Community guides for Classic BM call the rotation 'Aimed Shot on cooldown, Multi-Shot filler, ignore Serpent Sting and Arcane Shot' -- this rotation follows that and adds Bestial Wrath, timing it (and the shared Rapid Fire weave) so both land together as the one big burst window a Classic-length fight allows. Every rank named here is checked against this build's own spellconst: the fork's p1.apl.json preset names Multi-Shot as spell 25294, which does not exist in this build at all (Multi-Shot only has one rank here, 2643), and calls Serpent Sting rank 8 when 25295 is actually rank 9 in this build's spellconst -- both fixed here rather than copied stale.
